passage:
Students wanted more drinking fountains at their sports field. They created an online petition and shared it with classmates.
The petition got many signatures, but the school asked for more details. Where exactly were fountains needed? How often were students using the field? What problems happened during summer?
The students collected photos, counted teams, and recorded temperatures. Their second report was stronger.
The school agreed to add one fountain first and review the need for another.
The students learned that support matters, but evidence gives support direction. A petition says many people care. A plan shows what can be done.
